unit.why: A short anecdote, reported by R. Yehuda Zvi of Rozdol: his father-in-law R. Zvi sent a note by messenger to the graves of the Ari and Rashbi and signed it 'your disciple'.

stories.start_quote: בספר פעולת הצדיקים כי סיפר חתנו
stories.summary_en: R. Zvi's son-in-law testifies that he saw R. Zvi's handwritten note, sent by messenger to the graves of the Ari and R. Shimon bar Yohai, signed 'your disciple Zvi son of Hinda'.

quotes: ששלח פתקא ביד איש אחד על ציון
tags.why: A petition note is sent to be placed on holy graves.

quotes: על ציון המצויינת קדש הקדשים האריז"ל
tags.why: The note's destination is the graves in Safed and Meron, implied rather than named.
The tsaddik signs himself as the disciple of the dead sages.
The anecdote illustrates his humility and his reverence for the Ari and Rashbi.

quotes: סיפר חתנו הרה״ק מראזלא מו"ה יהודא צבי
tags.why: The son-in-law is the eyewitness narrator.
His mother Hinda is named only in the signature formula.

missing_concepts: kvitl / petition note to the dead
veneration of the Ari and Rashbi as heavenly masters
